name: Weather
description: Current conditions and a 7-day forecast for any number of places from Open-Meteo (no API key), found by city name

locations.description: Places in display order; the FIRST one is shown on the bar tile. Add places by name in the flyout: coordinates and time zone are looked up automatically. An empty list shows no weather until a place is added.

region.description: Optional context shown below the name, e.g. "Berlin, Germany"

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the place, e.g. "Europe/Berlin"; used for the ticking local time

units.description: Measurement units: metric (°C, km/h) or imperial (°F, mph)

coverLayout.description: Tile cover: place name as a small header over the conditions, or the weather icon with the temperature

tileRotates.description: Roll through every place on the bar tile instead of showing only the first one
